scripts.build: npm install --prefix web-dashboard && npm run build --prefix web-dashboard && npm install --prefix backend-api && npm run build --prefix backend-api
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix web-dashboard && npm install --prefix backend-api && npm install --prefix desktop-app && npm install --prefix mobile-app
scripts.deploy:hostinger: npm run install:all && npm run build && npm run start
scripts.ai:dev: cd ai-services && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn main:app --reload
scripts.ai:install: cd ai-services && python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
